page_title: CRY 2-3 EVE | Crystal Palace v Everton 11/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The match has just finished.
90+9' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) crosses the ball from the free kick, but it goes out of play.
90+7' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) has received a yellow card for his foul.
90+6' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) makes space inside the box for a shot, but his effort goes just wide of the left post.
90+4' Crystal Palace have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90' Sean Dyche decides to make a substitution. Ashley Young will be replaced by Nathan Patterson (Everton).
90' The fourth official shows 8 min. of added time.
89' Samuel Barrott shows a yellow card to James Garner (Everton) for a tough tackle.
89' Substitution. Will Hughes makes his way off the pitch and Naouirou Ahamada (Crystal Palace) comes on as his replacement.
88' Having seen unsporting behavior, Samuel Barrott shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Amadou Onana (Everton) is the recipient.
86' 2 - 3 Idrissa Gueye (Everton) connects with a pass inside the box and slams home into the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper was helpless.
83' It is time for a substitution. Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) is on for Odsonne Edouard.
82' Marc Guehi (Crystal Palace) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
81' The linesman points to the corner flag, Crystal Palace are going to take it.
79' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Crystal Palace.
77' Referee Samuel Barrott points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) goes wild in celebration.
77' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Beto (Everton) is coming onto the pitch as Dominic Calvert-Lewin cannot continue after picking up an injury.
76' Wait! Referee Samuel Barrott has indicated he is going to review the Crystal Palace goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
73' 2 - 2 Goal! It's a catastrophic error from the opponent which has gifted a chance to Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace), who rolls the ball into the back of the net from close range. 2:2.
72' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
72' It's a throw-in for Everton.
69' Crystal Palace take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
67' Substitution. Jeffrey Schlupp will be replaced by Michael Olise (Crystal Palace).
67' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) has a chance after receiving a pass. He measures his shot from the edge of the box but it sails just wide of the left post.
64' Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
61' The corner is swung in but Crystal Palace can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
58' The Everton players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
55' The referee points to the corner flag and Crystal Palace will take a corner.
55' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) fires a strong shot to the middle of the goal and the save is unexpectedly difficult for Jordan Pickford.
54' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
49' 1 - 2 Goal! Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) fires the rebound into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:2.
49' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Everton.
48' Jack Harrison (Everton) is penalised for a foul. Samuel Barrott had a clear view and blows his whistle.
46' Sean Dyche has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Idrissa Gueye comes on the pitch for Amadou Onana (Everton).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+5' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) sends the corner into the box, but Jordan Pickford intercepts it and averts the threat.
45+4' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
45+4' Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) hits a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a comfortable save for Jordan Pickford as it's directed low at the middle of the goal.
45+2' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) receives a yellow card.
45+1' PENALTY APPEAL by Everton, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
45' We will have 5 min. of added time.
44' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Jordan Pickford intercepts the ball.
43' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
40' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Dwight McNeil (Everton).
38' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Crystal Palace was in an offside position.
35' Jeffrey Schlupp (Crystal Palace) jumps into a tackle and Samuel Barrott signals a foul. A free kick is awarded to Everton.
34' Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
32' One of the Crystal Palace players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
29' James Garner (Everton) strikes a shot towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it flies just wide of the left post.
28' Joel Ward (Crystal Palace) sends a cross into the box, but Jordan Pickford comes off his line to gather the ball.
27' It’s the correct decision – NO PENALTY for Crystal Palace! VAR comes to the rescue of referee Samuel Barrott and both teams have no complaints.
26' Referee Samuel Barrott makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Crystal Palace. Let’s see what happens!
24' Booking. Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) receives a caution from the referee.
24' Crystal Palace enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.

22' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) connects with a cross from the side and steers a header from around the penalty spot towards the goal. The ball goes in the right direction, but it's stopped by one of the defenders.

18' Dwight McNeil (Everton) was presented with a great chance after a cross found him all alone in the box, but his low effort towards the middle of the goal lacked pace and was comfortably saved by Sam Johnstone.
17' Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
16' The resulting set piece from Crystal Palace is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
16' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
14' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
13' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
12' Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
9' A corner kick by Everton is thwarted by the well prepared Sam Johnstone (Crystal Palace).
9' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) is able to continue to play.
8' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
5' 1 - 1 Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) smoothly converts the penalty with a beautiful low drive into the right side of the goal.
5' Referee Samuel Barrott is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Crystal Palace!
5' Celebrations by Crystal Palace are cut short as the referee signals that the legality of the goal will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully this won’t take too long.
4' One of the Everton players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul. It's a penalty! What an opportunity to score for Crystal Palace.
1' 0 - 1 Jack Harrison showcases his great technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) gets onto the scoresheet by heading inside the left post. It's 0:1.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are on the pitch and Everton will have the kick-off.
Samuel Barrott got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
